start.title: Forty Days on Sinai
start.text:
The cloud has held you for weeks.
Below, the camp grows restless.

choices.text: Stay and hear every word of God
choices.feedback: Exodus 24:18 — Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: Hurry down before you are ready
choices.feedback: His work cannot be rushed.

haste_consequence.title: Wait on the Lord
haste_consequence.text:
His covenant must be received in full.
Return to His voice.

choices.text: Stay and hear every word of God
choices.feedback: You bow again before Him.

people_demand.title: "Where Is This Moses?"
people_demand.text:
The people press around Aaron.
"Make us gods to lead the way."

choices.text: (Aaron) Give in to keep the peace
choices.feedback: Fear of men silenced fear of God.

choices.text: (Aaron) Refuse and urge them to wait
choices.feedback: Exodus 32:2-4 — Aaron asked the people for their gold earrings and fashioned them into a molten calf.

choices.text: (Aaron) Blame Moses for the delay
choices.feedback: Blame builds no altar to God.

aaron_yields.title: Gold from Every Ear
aaron_yields.text:
Aaron gathers their rings and gold.
A fire is kindled in the camp.

choices.text: (In vision) See and grieve in spirit
choices.feedback: The Lord shows you their sin.

god_warns.title: "Go Down at Once"
god_warns.text:
"Your people have corrupted themselves.
They worship a calf of gold."

choices.text: Let His anger consume them
choices.feedback: His mercy seeks an intercessor.

choices.text: Plead for Israel before the Lord
choices.feedback: Exodus 32:11-13 — Moses pleaded with the Lord, reminding Him of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Israel.

choices.text: Ask Him to make a new nation of you
choices.feedback: His promise is not for you alone.

consume_consequence.title: Stand in the Gap
consume_consequence.text:
A shepherd does not abandon the flock.
Lift your voice for them.

choices.text: Plead for Israel before the Lord
choices.feedback: Your prayer rises like incense.

self_consequence.title: Not for Your Name
self_consequence.text:
His covenant is wider than you.
Pray for the people, not yourself.

choices.text: Plead for Israel before the Lord
choices.feedback: His anger relents at your words.

intercede.title: The Lord Relents
intercede.text:
His wrath turns from full ruin.
Now take the tablets and descend.

choices.text: Carry the tablets down to the camp
choices.feedback: Two stones, written by His finger.

descent.title: Sound of a Strange Song
descent.text:
Joshua hears war in the camp.
"No," you say. "It is revelry."

choices.text: Pretend you did not hear it
choices.feedback: Sin cannot be unheard.

choices.text: Press on toward the noisy camp
choices.feedback: Exodus 32:17-19 — Moses and Joshua descended the mountain, and Moses heard the sound of singing.

ignore_consequence.title: Face the Truth
ignore_consequence.text:
A leader cannot turn away.
Go and see what they have done.

choices.text: Press on toward the noisy camp
choices.feedback: Your jaw sets in resolve.

see_idol.title: The Calf and the Dance
see_idol.text:
Firelight glints on a golden idol.
The people circle it in song.

choices.text: Hide the tablets and walk on
choices.feedback: His law cannot be smuggled past sin.

choices.text: Throw the tablets down in holy wrath
choices.feedback: Exodus 32:19 — When Moses saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets from his hands, breaking them at the foot of the mountain.

choices.text: Join the circle to learn their hearts
choices.feedback: Holiness does not bow to idols.

hide_consequence.title: His Word Demands Response
hide_consequence.text:
The covenant they broke must be seen.
Let the stones speak truth.

choices.text: Throw the tablets down in holy wrath
choices.feedback: The crash silences the camp.

join_consequence.title: No Compromise with Idols
join_consequence.text:
Light cannot dance with darkness.
Stand against, not among.

choices.text: Throw the tablets down in holy wrath
choices.feedback: Your steps turn toward the altar.

tablets_broken.title: Silence in the Camp
tablets_broken.text:
The dancing stops. Eyes drop low.
The calf still gleams on its altar.

choices.text: Burn it, grind it, scatter the dust
choices.feedback: Exodus 32:20 — Moses took the calf they had made and burned it in the fire; he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water, and made the Israelites drink it.

choices.text: Leave the calf as a warning
choices.feedback: An idol left is an idol kept.

leave_consequence.title: Tear It Down
leave_consequence.text:
Idols must not be tolerated.
Destroy it without delay.

choices.text: Burn it, grind it, scatter the dust
choices.feedback: Hammer meets gold.

aaron_questioned.title: "What Did They Do to You?"
aaron_questioned.text:
Aaron stands trembling before you.
"The fire… and out came this calf."

choices.text: Shrug off the people's great sin
choices.feedback: Sin cannot be ignored.

choices.text: Call all who are for the Lord to you
choices.feedback: Exodus 32:26 — Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, "Whoever is for the Lord, come to me."

choices.text: Punish only Aaron and spare the rest
choices.feedback: All Israel shared this guilt.

shrug_consequence.title: Holiness Demands Action
shrug_consequence.text:
A camp unjudged learns nothing.
Call the faithful to stand.

choices.text: Call all who are for the Lord to you
choices.feedback: Your voice rings clear.

single_consequence.title: All Have Sinned
single_consequence.text:
Aaron alone cannot bear this.
The whole camp must repent.

choices.text: Call all who are for the Lord to you
choices.feedback: The Levites gather around you.

repentance.title: Hearts Bowed Low
repentance.text:
The camp kneels in dust and tears.
The Lord still walks with His people.

choices.text: Climb again to plead for forgiveness
choices.feedback: "Blot me out, but spare them."

ending.title: Mercy After Wrath
ending.text:
The covenant bruised but not broken.
Israel walks on, humbled and held.
